title: Would you trust an AI trading bot built by someone else with your own money?
author: fleatedplutmting
selftext:
Curious what everyone thinks about this.

Let's say someone builds an AI trading bot that has six months of independently verified live trading results, a solid win rate, transparent drawdowns and a consistent strategy.

Would you be willing to pay to use that bot yourself, or would you only ever trust something you've built and tested personally?

And if you would consider using someone else's bot, what would you absolutely need to see before trusting it with your capital?

Interested to hear from people who are already experimenting with AI trading bots.
